description: Secret names and governance metadata only. Secret values are prohibited.

secrets.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
secrets.required_scope: Workflow-declared permissions only; never copied or persisted

secrets.name: WORKER_API_TOKEN
secrets.required_scope: Authenticate only bounded internal Worker queue and cutover endpoints

secrets.name: WORKER_API_TOKEN_NEXT
consumers: Worker internal API during coordinated rotation
secrets.required_scope: Temporary alternate for WORKER_API_TOKEN rotation only

secrets.name: GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY
secrets.required_scope: App installation permissions declared by the registered application

secrets.name: SESSION_KEY
secrets.required_scope: At least 256 bits; unique to this Worker environment

secrets.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
secrets.required_scope: Deploy this Worker and read its secret-name inventory only

secrets.name: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
secrets.required_scope: Cloudflare account identifier paired with the deployment token

secrets.name: R2_ACCESS_KEY
secrets.required_scope: Write and read the configured analysis evidence bucket only

secrets.name: R2_SECRET_KEY
secrets.required_scope: Write and read the configured analysis evidence bucket only

secrets.name: R2_ACCOUNT_ID
secrets.required_scope: R2 account identifier; retained as a secret because workflows currently consume it through the secret store

secrets.name: SONAR_TOKEN
secrets.required_scope: Create trusted CI projects and submit exact-revision analysis; no source repository writes

secrets.name: SONAR_API_TOKEN
secrets.required_scope: User PAT with Browse permission on trusted CI projects

secrets.name: SNYK_TOKEN
secrets.required_scope: Read-only analysis for configured organization targets

secrets.name: CODERABBIT_GITHUB_TOKEN
secrets.required_scope: Read pull requests, checks, and comments for exact-head evidence

secrets.name: SCANNER_UPDATE_TOKEN
consumers: scanner update and tooling rollout workflows
secrets.required_scope: Contents, pull requests, workflows, issues, and commit statuses write; metadata, checks, and administration read

secrets.name: SECURITY_POSTURE_TOKEN
secrets.required_scope: Read configured repository security posture without source writes

scan_exclusions.reason: Reviewed scanner fixtures contain inert detection canaries.
Authentication tests construct an ephemeral in-memory private key and contain no retained key value.
Reviewed visual baselines are binary test assets.
